class_definitions.USER_DATA_REQUIRED: Exact user-specimen inference requires the matching user measurements when no exact public linkage exists. Not a declaration that all general/public-case scientific work needs private user data.
class_definitions.UNAVAILABLE: Only a documented bounded unavailable object/route; never inferred globally from nohit. No public candidate is assigned this class here.
